assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management.
CPT code 93226 is used for the 48-hour Holter monitor.
The service directly addresses the documented indication.
The service supports the diagnosis of I48.91.
The service supports the diagnosis of I47.1.
The claim was denied for the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT code 93226.
The denial is based on reason code PR-204.
The specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within one hundred eighty days of this notice.
